zh: 先要知道每个值出现了几次，然后按题目给的顺序把不同的值排好，取前 k 个即可。
排序规则是频次降序、频次相同时数值升序，等价于按二元组 (−频次, 数值) 升序排序。值域只有 −10000..10000，可以用哈希表或偏移后的数组计数。
统计每个值的频次，把所有出现过的不同值放进列表，按 (−频次, 数值) 排序，输出前 k 个，用空格分隔。题目保证 k 不超过不同值的个数。
en: First find how many times each value occurs, then sort the distinct values in the order the statement gives and take the first k.

The order is frequency descending and, for equal frequencies, value ascending, which is the same as sorting by the pair (-frequency, value) ascending. Values only range over -10000..10000, so a hash map or an offset array can do the counting.

Count each value's frequency, put the distinct values into a list, sort it by (-frequency, value), and print the first k separated by spaces. The statement guarantees k does not exceed the number of distinct values.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Count the frequencies, then sort by (-frequency, value).

## Proof of correctness

This sort key satisfies, item by item, "higher frequency first" and "on ties, the smaller value first".

## Complexity

O(n+d log d) time, O(d) space.
